prompt: Manage Pipedrive CRM records: find deals and contacts, update deal participants and primary contacts, log notes and activities, schedule follow-ups, inspect deal and organization custom fields, and bulk reclassify deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.

results.use_case: Manage Pipedrive CRM records: find deals and contacts, update deal participants and primary contacts, log notes and activities, schedule follow-ups, inspect deal and organization custom fields, and bulk reclassify deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Find best organization match using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS (extract nested items→item→id; treat empty items as no match).
[Optional (if an organization match exists and fields must be normalized)] [Step]: Update organization attributes/ownership using PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_AN_ORGANIZATION.
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Retrieve the organization’s current deals using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION_DEALS (prefer active deals to decide reuse vs new).
[Optional (if org linkage is unclear or deal may live elsewhere)] [Prerequisite]: Search candidate deals using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS (confirm reuse vs create).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: For each contact, look up existing people using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_PERSONS (dedupe before writes).
[Required] [Step]: Upsert each person using PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_PERSON_V2 (if found) or PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_PERSON (if not), storing final person id.
[Required] [Step]: If a suitable deal exists, align core fields using PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL; otherwise create a new deal using PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_DEAL.
[Optional (if multiple contacts must be associated)] [Next Step]: Link each person to the deal using PIPEDRIVE_ADD_DEAL_PARTICIPANT (repeat per person).
[Optional (if contextual notes are provided)] [Next Step]: Create a note using PIPEDRIVE_ADD_NOTE (attach to deal and/or person; keep concise valid HTML).
[Optional] [Fallback (if bulk calls hit HTTP 429)] : Re-run only failed items with smaller batches and backoff; use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH to checkpoint and retry safely.
known_pitfalls: [PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS] Success responses may still have no candidates; handle empty nested items safely before selecting an id.
[PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS] Multiple close matches are common; overly loose matching can attach updates/deals to the wrong organization.
[PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_PERSON] High-parallel upserts can hit HTTP 429 “request over limit”; batch work and retry failed records.
[PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_AN_ORGANIZATION] Bulk updates can also trigger HTTP 429; retry per record to avoid aborting the full run.
[PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS] Intermittent name-resolution/connector misconfiguration failures can persist until the connection context is corrected (repeating identical calls may not help).

PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS.description: Searches all organizations by name, address, notes and/or custom fields. This endpoint is a wrapper of /v1/itemSearch with a narrower OAuth scope.

term.description: The search term to look for. Minimum 2 characters (or 1 if using `exact_match`). Please note that the search term has to be URL encoded.

start.description: Pagination start. Note that the pagination is based on main results and does not include related items when using `search_for_related_items` parameter.

fields.description: A comma-separated string array. The fields to perform the search from. Defaults to all of them. Only the following custom field types are searchable: `address`, `varchar`, `text`, `varchar_auto`, `double`, `monetary` and `phone`. Read more about searching by custom fields here.

exact_match.description: When enabled, only full exact matches against the given term are returned. It is not case sensitive.

PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS.description: This API endpoint searches deals by title, notes, and custom fields, filters results by person or organization ID, and is a specific use case of /v1/itemSearch with limited OAuth scope.

term.description: The search term to look for. Minimum 2 characters required (or 1 character if exact_match is set to true). Please note that the search term has to be URL encoded.

limit.description: Items shown per page. Maximum value is 100.

start.description: Pagination start. Note that the pagination is based on main results and does not include related items when using `search_for_related_items` parameter.

fields.description: A comma-separated string array. The fields to perform the search from. Defaults to all of them. Only the following custom field types are searchable: `address`, `varchar`, `text`, `varchar_auto`, `double`, `monetary` and `phone`. Read more about searching by custom fields here.

status.description: Will filter deals by the provided specific status. open = Open, won = Won, lost = Lost. The upper limit of found deals associated with the status is 2000.

person_id.description: Will filter deals by the provided person ID. The upper limit of found deals associated with the person is 2000.

exact_match.description: When enabled, only full exact matches against the given term are returned. It is not case sensitive.

include_fields.description: Supports including optional fields in the results which are not provided by default

organization_id.description: Will filter deals by the provided organization ID. The upper limit of found deals associated with the organization is 2000.

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_DEAL.description: Add a new deal to Pipedrive with any custom fields, which vary by account and are identified by long hash keys. Check dealFields for existing custom fields. For details, visit the tutorial on adding a deal.

status.description: Status of the deal (open, won, lost). Defaults to open

user_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as owner of this deal

currency.description: Currency for the deal value (3-letter ISO code)

person_id.description: ID of the person this deal is linked to

visible_to.description: Visibility of the deal (owner, entire company etc)

expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in format YYYY-MM-DD

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL.description: Tool to update an existing deal in Pipedrive. Use when you need to modify properties of a deal such as title, value, status, stage, or associated contacts/organizations.

id.description: The ID of the deal to update

value.description: The monetary value of the deal

org_id.description: The ID of the organization associated with the deal

status.description: The status of the deal. Must be one of: open, won, lost

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the deal value

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the deal

stage_id.description: The ID of the stage within the pipeline

won_time.description: Date and time when status changed to won

label_ids.description: Array of label IDs assigned to the deal

lost_time.description: Date and time when status changed to lost

person_id.description: The ID of the person/contact associated with the deal

close_time.description: Date and time of closing the deal (for won/lost status)

is_archived.description: Whether the deal is archived. Note: From July 15, 2025, archived deals cannot be edited except for this property.

lost_reason.description: Reason for losing the deal. Required when status is set to 'lost'

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline for the deal. When changed, stage_id auto-updates to first stage.

archive_time.description: Date and time of archiving in UTC in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format

expected_close_date.description: Expected closing date in YYYY-MM-DD format

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_NOTE.description: Tool to add a note to a deal, person, organization, lead, or project in Pipedrive. Use when you need to create a note attached to an entity. At least one entity ID (lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id) must be provided.

org_id.description: The ID of the organization to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

examples: This is a note about the deal
content.description: The content of the note in HTML format. Subject to sanitization on the back-end.

deal_id.description: The ID of the deal to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

lead_id.description: The ID of the lead to attach the note to (UUID format). At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who will be marked as the author of the note. Only admins can change this.

add_time.description: The creation timestamp for the note in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

person_id.description: The ID of the person to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

pinned_to_deal_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the deal. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_lead_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the lead. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_person_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the person. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_project_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the project. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_organization_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the organization. 0 or omit to not pin.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION_DEALS.description: Lists deals associated with an organization. Use when you need to retrieve all deals linked to a specific organization with optional filtering and pagination.

sort.description: Field names and sorting mode separated by comma (e.g., 'add_time ASC'). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys).

status.description: Filter by deal status. Values: open, won, lost, deleted, all_not_deleted. If omitted, all not deleted deals are returned.

only_primary_association.description: If set to 1, only deals directly associated to the organization are fetched. If not set (default), all deals are fetched that are either directly or indirectly related to the organization. Values: 0 or 1
